title: The Essayes or Counsels, Civill and Morall (The Oxford Francis Bacon, Vol. 15)

publication.edition: Critical edition of the Essays (1597; enl. 1612, 1625)

verification.verification_notes: Confirmed the Essays appeared 1597 (10 essays) and expanded to 58 by 1625, and that Bacon's style ranges from plain to epigrammatic and aphoristic; used as a documented exemplar of compressed sententious form.

copyright.notes: Bacon's text public domain; modern critical edition copyrighted; no passages reproduced.
